question.html:
The results obtained from Geiger-Marsden-Rutherford scattering experiments provide evidence for the existence of the nucleus in atoms. Deviations from Geiger-Marsden-Rutherford scattering…

I.    provide evidence for the existence of the strong nuclear force.

II.   allow for an estimation of the radius of the nucleus.

III.  occur when alpha particles are incident at low energies.

Which statements are correct?

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
